camel_example: aliyun ada ListModels --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'next-token-example' --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --MaxResults 20 --ModelType text --version 2026-07-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the text models visible to the current caller for selection when setting a session model
description_zh: 查询当前调用方可见的文本模型，供设置会话模型时选择
kebab_example: aliyun ada list-models --max-results 20 --next-token next-token-example --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --model-type text --api-version 2026-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModels

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of models to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Explicitly specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的模型数，范围为 1～100。建议显式传入
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Omit this parameter for the first page
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的分页凭证，首页省略
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The legacy pagination parameter for compatibility. The page number starts from 1. Use MaxResults and NextToken instead. Do not mix the two sets of pagination parameters
parameters.help_zh: 存量兼容分页参数。页码从 1 开始。建议使用 MaxResults 和 NextToken，不应混用两套分页参数
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The legacy pagination parameter for compatibility. The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Use MaxResults and NextToken instead. Do not mix the two sets of pagination parameters
parameters.help_zh: 存量兼容分页参数。每页条数，取值 1～100。建议使用 MaxResults 和 NextToken，不应混用两套分页参数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Set to `text` for text sessions. If omitted, all visible models are queried
parameters.help_zh: 文本会话填写 `text`。省略时查询全部可见模型
parameters.name: model_type

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results used for this pagination. If not paginated, it is the total number of results. It is not the actual number of entries returned on this page
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次分页使用的最大结果数；未分页时为全量结果数。不是本页实际返回条数

Models.description_en: The array of model structures. For nested fields, refer to the supplementary description of response parameters
Models.description_zh: 模型结构数组，嵌套字段见返回参数补充说明

InputModalities.description_en: The supported input modalities. For text sessions, select a model that includes text
InputModalities.description_zh: 支持的输入模态。文本会话选择包含 text 的模型

items.description_en: An input modality supported by the model. text indicates text input
items.description_zh: 模型支持的一种输入模态，text 表示文本输入

ContextWindow.description_en: [Deprecated] The legacy compatibility field. It is no longer returned. Do not use it as a dependency for integration
ContextWindow.description_zh: 已弃用的兼容字段，当前不返回；不应作为接入依赖
ContextWindow.title_en: 默认上下文窗口（兼容字段）
ContextWindow.title_zh: 默认上下文窗口（兼容字段）

Created.description_en: The time when the model was created. It is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
Created.description_zh: 模型创建时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒

CreditsCoefficient.description_en: The credit coefficient of the model, returned as a decimal string. Not returned if not configured
CreditsCoefficient.description_zh: 模型积分系数，以十进制字符串返回；未配置时不返回

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the model. Do not pass it as the model identifier
DisplayName.description_zh: 模型展示名称，不作为模型标识传入

Id.description_en: The model identifier. Used as Params.modelId for SetAgentSessionModel. Use the actual returned value
Id.description_zh: 模型标识。用于 SetAgentSessionModel 的 Params.modelId，应使用实际返回值

MaxContextWindow.description_en: [Deprecated] The legacy compatibility field. It is no longer returned. Do not use it as a dependency for integration
MaxContextWindow.description_zh: 已弃用的兼容字段，当前不返回；不应作为接入依赖
MaxContextWindow.title_en: 最大上下文窗口（兼容字段）
MaxContextWindow.title_zh: 最大上下文窗口（兼容字段）

Object.description_en: The object type. Fixed to model

OwnedBy.description_en: The identifier of the model provider

SupportsThinking.description_en: [Deprecated] The legacy compatibility field. It is no longer returned. Use ThinkingLevels instead
SupportsThinking.description_zh: 已弃用的兼容字段，当前不返回；使用 ThinkingLevels
SupportsThinking.title_en: 思考能力开关（兼容字段）
SupportsThinking.title_zh: 思考能力开关（兼容字段）

ThinkingLevel.description_en: The default thinking level in the model catalog. It does not represent the current value of the session. Query the current value by using GetAgentSessionModel
ThinkingLevel.description_zh: 模型目录中的默认思考等级，不代表会话当前值；当前值通过 GetAgentSessionModel 查询

ThinkingLevels.description_en: The thinking levels supported by the model. An empty array does not mean all levels are supported. The target session still needs to be verified
ThinkingLevels.description_zh: 模型支持的思考等级。空数组不表示支持全部等级，目标会话仍需校验

items.description_en: A thinking level supported by the model. Refer to the model catalog return results for specific values
items.description_zh: 模型支持的一种思考等级，具体取值以模型目录返回结果为准

ThinkingMode.description_en: [Deprecated] The legacy compatibility field. It is no longer returned. Use ThinkingLevel instead
ThinkingMode.description_zh: 已弃用的兼容字段，当前不返回；使用 ThinkingLevel
ThinkingMode.title_en: 默认思考模式（兼容字段）
ThinkingMode.title_zh: 默认思考模式（兼容字段）

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. An empty value indicates that there is no next page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页凭证；为空表示没有下一页

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求 ID，用于问题排查

Total.description_en: The total number of models that meet the filter conditions
Total.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的模型总数
